name: Tonbo Imaging India Limited
summary: Tonbo Imaging India Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and sells electro-optical and infrared sensing, processing, communication, and guidance systems for defense, surveillance, and security applications. The company's tactical products include thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, hand-held thermal imaging binoculars, and targeting systems. It also provides platform-level products, such as fire control systems, missile seekers, and missile guidance systems. In addition, the company offers embedded vision systems and AI-accelerated image processing subsystems along with multi-axis gimbal stabilization systems for defense platforms.
